Two-mode monitor: `report` builds source-tagged multi-metric SEO/GEO performance reports with period-over-period deltas; `alert` designs threshold/anomaly alert configurations (triggers, priorities, response plans, routing) as a document for the user to implement.

Writes to memory/monitoring/ only after asking (SKILL.md:144). SKILL.md:63 recommends an optional zero-dependency helper `python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/connectors/ledger.py" record|diff|trend`; it does not ship with this skill, so deltas are computed manually from user-provided exports. Alert mode only produces a configuration summary; it does not send notifications or connect to Slack/email/PagerDuty itself. No installs or credentials.

Paid tools (~~analytics, ~~search console, ~~SEO tool, ~~AI monitor, ~~web crawler) are optional.
